item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera spends a summer afternoon at a beach in Chennai. During the day, the sand on the beach becomes hotter than the sea water, and the air above the sand rises. In which direction does the cool sea breeze blow near the shore in the afternoon?

options.A: from the land towards the sea, because the sea is warmer than the land
options.B: from the sea towards the land, because air rises above the warmer land and cooler air moves in from the sea
options.C: from the land towards the sea, because air rises above the warmer land
options.D: there is no breeze, because the sea and the land are at different temperatures
